142022.title: Chamba
142022.extract:
There is more than one place called Chamba:


India
Chamba (district) — a district in Himachal Pradesh, India
Chamba (Himachal Pradesh) — a town in Chamba District, Himachal Pradesh
Chamba (Uttarakhand) — a town in Garhwal, Uttarakhand, India


Ghana
Chamba (Ghana), a town in the Northern Region


Iran
Chamba (Khuzestan), a village in Khuzestan Province
Chamba (Zanjan), a village in Zanjan Province


Pakistan
Chamba (Abbottabad), a village in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province
Chamba (Mansehra), a village in the Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa province
